cohort: The study included 169 infants born to women with pregestational overweight/obesity (PGO) who were randomly supplemented with either 800 mg/day or 200 mg/day of DHA during pregnancy.
finding: Infants whose mothers received 800 mg/day DHA had significantly lower weight-for-length z-score and body mass index-for-age z-score during the first 4 months of life compared to those whose mothers received 200 mg/day DHA.
